title: Copis Analytics
description: An analytics project, you can get players analytics
body:
#

Copis Analytics

# Features ## Player Playtime Tracking - Tracks total playtime for each player, including current session. - Data is saved automatically to `config/copis_analytics.json`. ## Server Uptime - `/uptime` command shows how long the server has been running since startup. ## TPS Monitoring - `/tps` command shows the server’s current ticks per second in real time. ## Individual Playtime Check - `/playtime` command lets players see their personal total playtime. ## Persistent Data Storage - Player playtime is saved and loaded across server restarts. - Uses JSON file storage for easy access and management. Works on Fabric and compatible plugin servers.
